name: Noddi Amico - Deprecated
summary: This app will fit the Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging (NODDI; Zhang et al, 2012) model to multi-shell, normalized DWI data using the Accelerated Microstructure Imaging via Convex Optimization (AMICO; Daducci et al, 2015) toolbox.
description: This app will fit the Neurite Orientation Dispersion and Density Imaging (NODDI; Zhang et al, 2012) model to multi-shell, normalized DWI data using the Accelerated Microstructure Imaging via Convex Optimization (AMICO; Daducci et al, 2015) toolbox. Requires normalized, multi-shell DWI data (including bvals and bvecs) and an optional brainmask of the DWI. Will output the four NODDI output files: neurite density index (ndi), orientation dispersion index (odi), isotropic volume fraction (isovf), and the directions (dirs).

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
mask needs to be made from DWI image

outputs.description: The NODDI (deprecated) measures fit using AMICO

parameters.description: The parallel diffusivity parameter. For white matter analyses, use 0.0017. For cortical mapping, use 0.0011

Sometimes mask generation does not remove all of the non-brain material. If True, this will make sure the non-brain material is fully removed. Only check if inputting a mask that contains non-brain material
Select this if you want to perform signal debiasing before NODDI fit
